findings.message: The MD5 of the audio in STREAMINFO is 0, which means the encoder did not know it; the audio cannot be checked against it.
The frame at 0x112 cannot be read: the subframe of channel 1 has a type the specification reserves.
The frame at 0x209 cannot be read: the subframe of channel 1 starts with a bit the specification reserves as 0.
The frame at 0x30B cannot be read: the subframe of channel 1 states as many wasted bits as the sample has bits.
The frame at 0x414 cannot be read: the subframe of channel 1 states the forbidden coefficient precision.
The frame at 0x523 cannot be read: the subframe of channel 1 states a negative coefficient shift.
The frame at 0x636 cannot be read: the subframe of channel 1 has a residual coding method the specification reserves.
The frame at 0x748 cannot be read: the subframe of channel 1 has a partition order that the block size does not divide into.
The frame at 0x94B cannot be read: the subframe of channel 1 has a Rice code whose value does not fit 32 bits.
